name: Level Crossing
summary: A country railway crossing: call a train, the gates swing down, traffic queues and birds scatter
about: A level crossing between mustard fields, drawn in SVG with real perspective: cars, rickshaws, motorbikes and minibuses drive up and down the road in both lanes. Call a train and the bell rings, the red lamps flash, the striped gates swing down on springs, traffic brakes into a queue and the birds on the wire fly off while an express, a goods train or a slow local rumbles past. Good for a travel or logistics page, a kids' site or a calm animated header.
how: Pick Express, Goods or Local and press Call the train (or tap the cabin or the signal).
Watch the bell and lamps start, the gates drop with a bounce and the cars stop at the line.
When the last wagon's red lamp has gone, the keeper waves a green flag, the gates lift and the queue drives on.
Press Add a car to send more traffic, and tap any vehicle to make it honk.
Day or night follows your theme; the cabin clock shows the real time, and reduced motion removes the rumble and bounce.
